about.title: About
about.bio: Dr. Sohee Park is an Associate Professor at the Graduate School of Convergence Health and Medicine, Yonsei University. Her research focuses on leveraging advanced data science and artificial intelligence methodologies to address critical challenges in biomedical and public health domains. She has published extensively in top-tier journals and conferences, and her work has been recognized with multiple awards.
